items.title: Terry McLaurin: Not spotted Thursday
items.text:
McLaurin (hamstring) wasn't present for warmups Thursday after missing Wednesday's practice, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

items.title: Stefon Diggs: Back at practice Thursday
items.text:
Diggs (hamstring) returned to practice Thursday, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

items.title: Rico Dowdle: Chance to return against Colts
items.text:
Head coach mike McCarthy said Thursday that it remains up in the air whether Dowdle (toe) will be available Sunday against the Colts, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Michael Pittman: Aggravates foot injury
items.text:
Pittman is expected to miss multiple weeks after aggravating his foot injury, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports Thursday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jayden Daniels: No limitations expected in return
items.text:
Offensive coordinator David Blough said Thursday that Daniels (left elbow) is "full go" for Sunday's game against the Giants and won't have any limitations, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.
